IGUI_SFQuest_EzekielFlynn_Intro_Lore: Ezekiel will help me understand how to move within this world. He will leave me a weapon once he has shown him that those things, do not scare me.
IGUI_SFQuest_EzekielFlynn_Intro_Complete: Hey, newcomer! Welcome to the Den. I'm Ezekiel. There are no formal introductions or handshakes here. Out here only one thing counts: surviving. And judging by your appearance, I'd say you haven't learned to do it well yet. But don't worry, if you made it this far it means you have something inside you. Something worth strengthening. I'm not going to lie to you: this place is better than nothing, but it's not safe. We call it a shelter, but in reality it's just a break between one nightmare and another. Out there there are the Dead, and worse, the living. People who have no qualms about taking everything from you. But if you follow my instructions, you might have a chance. First lesson: never take anything for granted. Your best weapon is not a rifle, it's not a knife… it's your head. Think before you move. If you make noise, you attract trouble. If you let your guard down, you're dead. I've seen too many guys like you end badly because they thought they were smarter than anyone else. So here's what we're going to do. I'll teach you how to defend yourself. Nothing complicated, let's start with hand-to-hand combat. Once you've shown you're not a dead weight, I'll give you something useful… maybe a crowbar. It doesn't seem like much, but believe me, in certain situations it's worth more than gold. Now, tell me: are you just here to escape something or do you really want to learn to survive?

IGUI_SFQuest_Questyno_ElowenBeckett_Intr: Elowen will help me understand how to move within this world. She will leave me a Wheelbarrow that will help me transport large quantities of objects if I give her a hand in retrieving the materials.

Finally, another one who thinks he can survive here. Let's see if you're just another naive person destined to become food for the Dead, or if you really have what it takes. I'm Elowen, and unlike Ezekiel, I don't have time for motivational speeches. Here you work, or you die. You want to stay alive? Then start doing things right. First rule: don't lose your stuff. I see too many fools walking around with all their gear on them, as if they were immortal. Then, surprise! They end up being eaten by a horde and everything they had on them becomes loot for the next desperate person. If you want to survive more than a few days, I'll teach you how to keep your things safe. You'll need a Sleeping Bag and I'll give it to you if you prove yourself worthy. It's not just for sleeping: it's your space, your refuge. Use your head and choose a place to put it. If someone finds it, they might steal everything from you, so don't be a fool. Second rule: don't do useless work. Here we don't have gasoline to spare or trucks full of supplies. We have to make do. Have you ever thought about how to transport a lot of materials without breaking your back? No? Well, you will. I'll teach you how to build a wheelbarrow. Nothing fancy, just wheels, wood and a little ingenuity. It will cost you effort, but it will save you time and sweat. And believe me, in this world, time and energy are more precious than food. So, are you going to stand there or do you want to learn to do something useful?
I need you to retrieve some tools from a garage.

IGUI_SFQuest_Pyno1_Begin_Text: Welcome to the Kingdom of Pyno! Enter Discord (press Y for the link) for maps, tips and to interact with other players. Weekly/monthly events and live streams on Twitch (pynoTTV) offer spoilers and updates. Respect everyone and report misconduct or cheats: we want a fair challenge and a healthy community. Problems? Open a ticket in-game or on Discord. After a lot of work with Ioshi and Vorshim, the server offers 50+ NPCs and over 500 missions, in a world with over 50 Cities. If you want to support the project, find out on Discord how to contribute!

IGUI_SFQuest_Pyno2_Begin_Text: NPCs guide you in the early stages, providing essential items such as a crowbar, a Bike, a generator etc... as well as missions to earn Reputation and unlock other NPCs and rewards. The system is now a real RPG, where skills can be upgraded to level 4 and beyond, using special in-game drugs. Loot is limited and zombies respawn quickly, making the game challenging. You can earn money through kills and receive rewards for kills and days of survival. With the Server Point Shop, you will get points for purchasing the 'Special Diary,' reserved for server veterans.

IGUI_SFQuest_Pyno3_Begin_Text: The map is divided into Tiers. Each Tier presents increasingly sturdy and fast zombies (see icon on the right), but also loot in greater quantity and quality on the Zeds. In addition, there are also Radioactive zones (require a Hazmat Suit or Gas Mask), where you can get missions for vaccines, weapons and special armor. By opening the map, you can see with the mouse the name of the city and the Tier (in addition to the radioactive zones), even if you have not yet visited these zones. By increasing Reputation, in addition, you will unlock personal Safehouses, increasingly larger. Sometimes they will be 'mobile' (Sleeping bag and then Tent) sometimes they will be 'fixed' (like 6x6 or the various rooms of the Den or the Citadel)

IGUI_SFQuest_Pyno5_Begin_Text: To activate the account, right-click on the Credit card and select 'Link'. You will always see the balance and you can transfer money from your inventory or send it to other players. In case of loss, link a new card without losing the balance. Check the wallets of zombie corpses to find extra dollars, to use at the Resistance Market or withdraw there. With the first money, buy a Pot to sterilize rags or collect water from the well, or consider flashlight and lighter. Good luck, and use the pen to mark the Den on the map! (M key)
